primary_endpoint: Resolution of NASH with no worsening of fibrosis at 72 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis occurred in 59% with semaglutide 0.4 mg versus 17% with placebo (P<0.001). Fibrosis-stage improvement occurred in 43% versus 33% (P=0.48).
safety_signal: With semaglutide 0.4 mg versus placebo, nausea occurred in 42% vs. 11%, constipation in 22% vs. 12%, and vomiting in 15% vs. 2%. Malignant neoplasms were reported in 3 semaglutide-treated patients (1%) and none receiving placebo.
